lines.en: label beachsix5:
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene chikautabed1
Two bisexuals were sitting on a bed, not being bisexual {i}at{/i} each other because life is cruel and sometimes girls don’t kiss each other even when everyone knows they should.
lines.zh: 两个双性恋正坐在一张床上，却没有对彼此{i}做{/i}双性恋该做的事，因为生活就是这么残酷，有时候明明所有人都知道两个女孩该亲上去，她们却偏不亲。

lines.en: That said, this didn’t mean they weren’t {i}thinking{/i} about kissing girls, though.
lines.zh: 不过话又说回来，这也不代表她们没在{i}想{/i}着亲女孩。

lines.en: For Uta was a somewhat closeted pervert who had a baseline level of always thinking about things like that, whereas it was a relatively {i}new{/i} phenomenon for Chika.
lines.zh: 毕竟 Uta 是个多少藏着点变态心思的人，脑子里本来就随时在想这种事；而对 Chika 来说，这还是个比较{i}新鲜{/i}的现象。

lines.en: She’d always been open to the possibility of such a thing. Just it seemed like more of an {i}actual possibility{/i} now that she’d gotten a literal taste of what life like that could be like.
lines.zh: 她一向不排斥这种可能性。只是在真的尝过那种生活是什么滋味之后，它看起来更像一个{i}现实的可能{/i}了。

lines.en: This made her sad, though. It made her feel {i}unclean.{/i} Because even if the man she loved would routinely do the same to her, Chika never believed she would follow suit.
lines.zh: 可这让她难过。让她觉得自己{i}不干净{/i}。因为就算她爱的那个男人经常对她做同样的事，Chika 也从不相信自己会跟着学。

lines.en: But she also never believed she could change so much in such a short span of time, and she was finally, albeit somewhat reluctantly, coming around to the fact that she actually {i}had.{/i}
lines.zh: 可她也从不相信自己能在这么短的时间里变这么多，而如今她终于——虽然多少有点不情愿——开始接受自己确实{i}变了{/i}这个事实。

lines.en: What did this change of perspective mean for her, though? And would {i}he{/i} find her actions as disloyal and despicable as she did?
lines.zh: 可这种转变对她来说意味着什么？{i}他{/i}会不会也像她一样，觉得自己的行为既背叛又卑劣？

lines.en: Would {i}he{/i} break up with {i}her{/i} if that happened? And, if he did, would that feel more like being set free rather than being hurt?
lines.zh: 如果真是这样，{i}他{/i}会跟{i}她{/i}分手吗？而如果他真分了，那种感觉会不会更像被放生，而不是被伤害？

lines.en: For the hurt would come regardless — and it came quite frequently at that. But it was only because she had grown weak in her complacency. And she still had room to grow.
lines.zh: 因为伤痛迟早会来——而且还来得相当频繁。但那只是因为她在自满中变得软弱了。而她还有成长的余地。

lines.en: She had a lot to think about. And now that the girl these thoughts centered around had left the beach, there was little to do but drown in her excited uncertainty.
lines.zh: 她有很多要想的。而既然这些念头的中心那个女孩已经离开了海滩，她除了沉溺在那种兴奋又不安的情绪里，也别无他事可做。

lines.en: : Uta, can I ask you a question?
lines.zh: Uta，我能问你个问题吗？

lines.en: : No, I will not swap shifts with you next weekend. My customers depend on Uta-chan to find the will to keep on living. I’m afraid I can not let them down.
lines.zh: 不行，下周末我不会跟你换班。我的客人还得靠 Uta 酱才有活下去的动力。我可不能让他们失望。

lines.en: : It’s not about work. I was just wondering if you’ve ever hooked up with a girl before.
lines.zh: 不是工作的事。我只是想知道你以前有没有跟女生搞过。

lines.en: scene chikautabed2
: Wha- huh?! Where did that...uhh...me?! Why?! What’s happening?!
lines.zh: 什——哈？！怎么突然……呃……我？！为什么？！什么情况？！

lines.en: : I’ve just been a little...curious lately, I guess. Just wanted to know if you have any experience.
lines.zh: 我最近就是有点……好奇吧。想知道你有没有经验。

lines.en: scene chikautabed3
: Uhh...well...I...umm...
: If you...{i}really{/i} want to, and...we keep it a secret, I...
lines.zh: 如果你……{i}真的{/i}想，而且……我们保密的话，我……

lines.en: : Suppose we could try?...
lines.zh: 也许我们可以试试？……

lines.en: scene chikautabed4
: Hm? Try what? What do you mean?
lines.zh: 嗯？试什么？你什么意思？

lines.en: scene chikautabed5
: What do {i}you{/i} mean?! Before I dig myself into a deeper hole!
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}是什么意思？！趁我还没把自己挖进更深的坑里！

lines.en: scene chikautabed6
: Ugh...I wish I knew how to talk about it without just...giving everything away.
lines.zh: 呃……我要是知道怎么开口、又不至于……全盘托出就好了。

lines.en: scene chikautabed7
: I...don’t mind if you...give everything away.
lines.zh: 我……不介意你……全盘托出。

lines.en: : You can even be extremely explicit and describe things in vivid detail if that helps you feel more comfortable talking about them.
lines.zh: 你甚至可以说得非常露骨、把细节描述得活灵活现，只要这样能让你说得更自在。

lines.en: : Mnh...{i}no.{/i} I don’t want it to impact the way you look at me.
lines.zh: 嗯……{i}不要{/i}。我不想让它影响你怎么看我。

lines.en: : {i}I do.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我想。{/i}

lines.en: : It’s just, like...Wouldn’t dating someone from our class be, like...{i}way{/i} more convenient than dating some...I don’t know. Let’s just say an older guy for an example.
lines.zh: 就是……比如说，跟我们班的人交往，不是比跟某个……我不知道，比如说某个年纪更大的男人交往，{i}方便多了{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene chikautabed8
: Well yeah, but...dating’s not about convenience, right? It’s about, like...love and stuff.
lines.zh: 是没错，可是……交往又不是为了图方便，对吧？是为了……爱什么的。

lines.en: : Right. But assuming you love two people and one of them just makes infinitely more sense than the other...then what? What would you do?
lines.zh: 对。可假设你同时爱着两个人，其中一个明显比另一个合理得多……那怎么办？你会怎么做？

lines.en: : Uh...I...I really don’t know...I’ve never felt that way about more than one person at a time before.
lines.zh: 呃……我……我真的不知道……我从来没同时喜欢过两个人。

lines.en: scene chikautabed9
: Ugh! Me neither! That’s why I’m so confused!
lines.zh: 呃！我也是！所以我才这么迷茫！

lines.en: : Chika...do you actually, like...have feelings for somebody that {i}isn’t{/i} Sensei? Specifically a...girl from our class?
lines.zh: Chika……你是不是真的……对某个{i}不是{/i} Sensei 的人有感觉？具体说……是我们班的某个女生？

lines.en: scene chikautabed10
: I don’t know...maybe? We’re close as friends though and I don’t want it to, like...fuck anything up.
lines.zh: 我不知道……也许吧？不过我们作为朋友很亲近，我不想……把事情搞砸。

lines.en: : Ohhh...cool. Cool, cool. Yeah, that makes sense. (Internally screaming, horny, and suddenly getting the wrong idea.)
lines.zh: 哦哦哦……挺好。挺好挺好。嗯，说得通。（内心在尖叫，在发情，而且突然开始会错意。）

lines.en: : Also, if you tell anyone about this, I {i}will{/i} kill you.
lines.zh: 还有，如果你告诉任何人，我{i}一定{/i}杀了你。

lines.en: : I...won’t tell anyone about...{i}anything{/i} you say in here, Chika...
lines.zh: 我……不会把你在屋里说的{i}任何{/i}话告诉任何人，Chika……

lines.en: : I also, um...well, you know...And it’s not like you can just stop how you’re feeling, so...I think just being honest is probably...um...for the best?...Maybe?...
lines.zh: 而且，嗯……就是那个……反正你也没法说停就停下自己的感觉，所以……我觉得还是诚实一点大概……嗯……比较好？……也许吧？……

lines.en: : Do you...want to, like...come a little closer or something? J...Just so we can be, like...extra sure nobody hears.
lines.zh: 你要不要……那个……再靠近一点什么的？就……就只是为了确保……绝对没人听见。

lines.en: : No, I’m fine over here. Nobody else is in the room. Thanks, though.
lines.zh: 不用，我在这儿挺好的。屋里又没别人。不过还是谢谢。

lines.en: scene chikautabed11
: I just wish she was still here, you know? Like, her leaving threw my whole weekend off.
lines.zh: 我只是希望她还在这儿，你懂吗？她这一走，把我整个周末都搞乱了。

lines.en: scene chikautabed12
: Wait. {i}Leaving?{/i} But that would mean-
lines.zh: 等等。{i}走了？{/i}那岂不是意味着——

lines.en: scene chikautabed13
: Oh my God! You like Rin!
lines.zh: 我的天啊！你喜欢 Rin！

lines.en: : Well...yeah. Maybe. Who else would I be talking about?
lines.zh: 嗯……是吧。也许吧。不然我还能在说谁？

lines.en: scene chikautabed14
: Nobody! {i}Definitely{/i} not anyone you work with! That would be inappropriate and wrong!
lines.zh: 没有！{i}绝对{/i}不是跟你一起工作的谁！那可不合适、也不对！

lines.en: scene chikautabed15
: It’s inappropriate and wrong either way, though! I already {i}have{/i} a boyfriend! I just got swept up in the moment and wanted her to know she’s loved!
lines.zh: 可不管怎么说都是不合适、不对的！我{i}已经{/i}有男朋友了！我只是一时冲动，想让她知道有人爱她！

lines.en: scene chikautabed16
: Sensei hooks up with other girls all the time. I can be forgiven for just doing it {i}once,{/i} right?
lines.zh: Sensei 整天跟别的女生乱搞。我就{i}做了一次{/i}，总能被原谅吧？

lines.en: : So...you guys actually, like...hooked up?
lines.zh: 所以……你们真的……那个了？

lines.en: : .......Yeaaaaah.
: Among...{i}other{/i} things.
lines.zh: 还……{i}不止{/i}那样。

lines.en: : .......{i}Other{/i} things?
: It is......possible that I may have......uh......
: Performed oral sex on her?
lines.zh: 给她口交了？

lines.en: scene chikautabed17
: Uta?
lines.zh: Uta？

lines.en: scene chikautabed18
: Yes?
lines.zh: 怎么？

lines.en: : You’re not going to tell anybody, right? Because I’m really putting myself out there by admitting this to you right now.
lines.zh: 你不会告诉任何人吧？我现在跟你说这些，真的是把自己完全摊开来了。

lines.en: : Secret’s safe with me. I don’t think I’d be able to repeat that out loud if I tried.
lines.zh: 秘密在我这儿很安全。那种话我大概就算想复述也说不出声。

lines.en: : Ever since then, I...I don’t know. Like...I don’t {i}want{/i} to feel so...{i}attracted{/i} to her. But I also kind of feel, like...like I’ve maybe felt this way for a while and...I’ve just been hiding from it?
lines.zh: 从那以后，我……我不知道。就是……我{i}不想{/i}对她这么……{i}心动{/i}。可我又有点觉得……觉得我可能早就这么想了，只是一直在逃避？

lines.en: scene chikautabed19
: And now she’s saying she likes {i}Sensei{/i} and it’s, like...what do I even do? I don’t want to just forget that ever happened between us. It was...special for me.
lines.zh: 现在她又说她喜欢{i}Sensei{/i}，我就……我到底该怎么办？我不想就这么当我们之间那件事没发生过。那对我来说……很特别。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ve, um...{i}thought{/i} about this already...but I highly doubt Sensei would be opposed to, like...you know...{i}both{/i} of you. At once.
lines.zh: 我猜你大概已经……{i}想过{/i}了吧……不过我严重怀疑 Sensei 不会反对……就是……你懂的……你们{i}两个{/i}。一起。

lines.en: : If you’re talking about a threesome, then yes. He’d be all for it.
lines.zh: 如果你说的是三人性交，那没错。他肯定举双手赞成。

lines.en: : But, like...See, this is where it gets weird. Because thinking about him doing stuff like that with {i}her{/i} pisses me off. Like, I want {i}her{/i} to be off limits.
lines.zh: 可是……你瞧，这就是奇怪的地方。因为一想到他跟{i}她{/i}做那种事，我就火大。我就想让{i}她{/i}成为禁区。

lines.en: : And since {i}she’s{/i} the one I’m worried about in that scenario, doesn’t that mean I like her on a level maybe even {i}higher{/i} than the one I like him on? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: 既然在那个设想里我担心的是{i}她{/i}，那是不是说明我对她的喜欢，可能比我对他的喜欢还要{i}高{/i}一层？我搞不明白。

lines.en: : This, uhh...this sounds pretty serious, Chika. Have you, like...talked to {i}her{/i} about it? Because Rin liked you for a {i}really{/i} long time, didn’t she?
lines.zh: 这个……嗯……听起来挺严重的，Chika。你有没有……跟{i}她{/i}谈过？因为 Rin 喜欢你可是喜欢了{i}很久很久{/i}，不是吗？

lines.en: : A {i}really{/i} long time. So now I feel like a fucking asshole because what I did rightfully confused the hell out of her at the same time she’s starting to be honest with herself about her feelings for Sensei.
lines.zh: {i}很久很久{/i}。所以我现在觉得自己是个混蛋，因为我做的事把她彻底搞懵了，而偏偏她这时才开始正视自己对 Sensei 的感情。

lines.en: scene chikautabed20
: That’s not what I wanted to do, though! Like...I don’t want to {i}confuse{/i} her! She has enough going on as-is. And I still love Sensei too!
lines.zh: 可那不是我想要的结果啊！我……我不想{i}把她搞糊涂{/i}！她本来就够烦的了。而且我也还爱着 Sensei！

lines.en: : So it’s, like...do I just {i}drop{/i} this? What would you do in my shoes?
lines.zh: 所以就是……我要不要干脆{i}放{/i}下？换作是你，你会怎么做？

lines.en: scene chikautabed21
: It’s...hard to answer that question when I’ve never been in a situation like that.
lines.zh: 这……很难回答，毕竟我从来没遇到过这种情况。

lines.en: : I think the two of us are kind of similar in...{i}how{/i} we like people, though. Because I’m also really obsessive when it comes to stuff like that. Just maybe not as...{i}possessive{/i} as you?
lines.zh: 不过我觉得我们俩在……{i}喜欢人的方式{/i}上有点像。因为我在这种事上也很偏执。只是大概没你那么……{i}占有欲强{/i}？

lines.en: : You think I’m possessive?
lines.zh: 你觉得我占有欲强？

lines.en: : Of course. That’s why you don’t want Sensei touching Rin, right? And why you didn’t want anyone touching Sensei before eventually giving up on that.
lines.zh: 当然。所以你才不想让 Sensei 碰 Rin，对吧？还有你以前也不想让任何人碰 Sensei，后来才慢慢放弃的。

lines.en: : Is that really visible to other people? I thought I did a good job of hiding it.
lines.zh: 别人真看得出来吗？我还以为自己藏得挺好的。

lines.en: scene chikautabed22
: I honestly can’t tell if you’re joking or not.
lines.zh: 说实话我真分不清你是在开玩笑还是认真的。

lines.en: : Ugh...this whole thing just sucks. And I, like...can’t even be mad at Sensei anymore since I’m doing the same thing he is.
lines.zh: 呃……整件事真是糟透了。而且我现在……连生 Sensei 的气都生不起来，因为我在做跟他一样的事。

lines.en: scene chikautabed23
: Chika...I don’t think hooking up with Rin {i}one{/i} time is anywhere near the level of what Sensei is doing. I think you just made a mistake.
lines.zh: Chika……我觉得你跟 Rin 就{i}那一次{/i}，根本比不上 Sensei 在做的事。我觉得你只是一时犯错。

lines.en: : {i}Was{/i} it a mistake, though?...Because that’s the part I can’t figure out. I want {i}more{/i} of her. I’m just afraid to act on it because I don’t know how she or Sensei would feel.
lines.zh: 可那{i}算{/i}是犯错吗？……因为这正是我想不通的地方。我想要{i}更多{/i}的她。我只是不敢行动，因为我不知道她还有 Sensei 会怎么想。

lines.en: : And that’s not even accounting for the general {i}grossness{/i} I feel coming onto her in the first place after straight up rejecting her years ago. I don’t deserve her at all after that.
lines.zh: 更别说几年前我干脆利落地拒绝过她，现在反过来对她有这种感觉，本身就让我觉得{i}恶心{/i}。那样之后我根本配不上她。

lines.en: : You’re being too hard on yourself for just...having feelings, Chika. We all do things that make ourselves feel gross sometimes. That doesn’t mean you actually {i}are,{/i} though.
lines.zh: 你只是在……有感觉而已，别把自己逼得太紧，Chika。我们都会做一些让自己觉得恶心的事。可那不代表你真的{i}就是{/i}那样的人。

lines.en: : Easy for you to say when {i}you’ve{/i} never done anything like that before.
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}又没做过那种事，说起来当然轻松。

lines.en: scene chikautabed24
: At least not as far as I know. But I live in a state of perpetual skepticism about which of my friends are fucking my boyfriend now. So I doubt I’d be surprised if you {i}had.{/i} No offense.
lines.zh: 至少据我所知没有。不过我现在长久处于一种怀疑状态，猜着身边又有哪个朋友在跟我男朋友上床。所以就算你{i}做过{/i}，我大概也不会惊讶。无意冒犯。

lines.en: : I’ve never...done anything like that with a boy or...a girl or...anyone before. I can’t take initiative the way you can. I just suffer in silence while everyone else finds happiness.
lines.zh: 我从来……没跟男生、或者女生、或者任何人做过那种事。我没法像你那样主动。我只能默默受着，看着别人一个个找到幸福。

lines.en: : As a rival, I’m relieved to hear that. But as your friend, I think it’s important for you to know that practically {i}no one{/i} would ever refuse a girl like you, Uta.
lines.zh: 作为情敌，听到这话我松了口气。可作为朋友，我觉得你有必要知道：像你这样的女孩，几乎{i}没人{/i}会拒绝，Uta。

lines.en: : If you actually {i}did{/i} take initiative every once in a while, I wouldn’t be surprised if you pulled ahead of everyone we know. You’re just depriving yourself at this point.
lines.zh: 如果你真的偶尔{i}肯{/i}主动一下，你要是能超过我们认识的所有人，我一点都不会意外。你现在只是在亏待自己。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, you’re overestimating just how desirable a girl like me is. Everything about {i}you{/i} screams “wife.” I just exist as fodder for people to get their rocks off to.
lines.zh: 可惜你高估了我这种女孩的吸引力。{i}你{/i}浑身上下都写着「老婆」两个字。我存在的意义不过是给人当发泄用的材料。

lines.en: scene chikautabed25
: Woah! That’s not true at all. I’m sure you’ll make somebody the happiest man or woman in the world one day. Just keep {i}me{/i} away from them or I might fuck both.
lines.zh: 哇！这完全不是真的。我敢肯定总有一天你会让某个人成为世上最幸福的男人或女人。只要让{i}我{/i}离他们远点，不然我可能两个都睡。

lines.en: : Won’t have to since chances are you’ll get to them before me. I’ll be on the lookout, though.
lines.zh: 用不着，反正你大概会比我先得手。不过我会留意的。

lines.en: scene chikautabed26
: Do you want to vent now? My turn is over.
lines.zh: 现在轮到你倾诉了吗？我的回合结束了。

lines.en: : I feel a lot better now that I’ve actually got to {i}talk{/i} to somebody about all of this. Even if I’m still just as fucked as I was before. Literally {i}and{/i} figuratively.
lines.zh: 能真的跟人{i}聊{/i}了这些，我好受多了。哪怕我还是跟之前一样糟糕。字面意义上{i}和{/i}比喻意义上都是。

lines.en: : I’m okay, Chika. You’re not the only one afraid of how people will see you when they find out what you really are.
lines.zh: 我没事，Chika。害怕别人知道真实的自己之后会怎么看你的人，不止你一个。

lines.en: scene chikautabed27
: Well, what the hell is that supposed to mean? You’re not, like...secretly embezzling money from the maid cafe or robbing your customers blind, are you?
lines.zh: 喂，这话什么意思？你该不会……偷偷从女仆咖啡厅挪用公款，或者把客人坑得精光吧？

lines.en: scene chikautabed28
: There’s no need to — for Uta-chan is already the perfect maid. Embezzlement is for girls like Ami who come in last place on the rankings and try to kiss you in the locker room.
lines.zh: 没那个必要——因为 Uta 酱已经是完美的女仆了。挪用公款是 Ami 那种排名垫底、还想在更衣室里亲你的女孩才干得出来的事。

lines.en: : God, imagine how many of our problems would be solved if she was obsessed with you instead of her fucking uncle.
lines.zh: 天啊，想想看，要是她迷恋的是你而不是她那个该死的叔叔，我们得少多少麻烦。

lines.en: scene chikautabed29
: I’m surprised you still see her as a problem at all now that you know Sensei gets around faster than a 10-speed bike.
lines.zh: 既然你知道 Sensei 到处乱搞的速度比十速自行车还快，我还挺意外你竟然还把她当问题。

lines.en: : Also, he’s her {i}dad.{/i} And if you really love him, you’ll honor his wishes by going along with that even {i}if{/i} you don’t like Ami very much.
lines.zh: 还有，他是她{i}爸爸{/i}。如果你真的爱他，就算{i}不{/i}太喜欢 Ami，也该尊重他的意愿、顺着这一点。

lines.en: scene chikautabed30
: Oh, right. I forgot you actually {i}do.{/i} Seems like mostly everybody else has given up on her by now.
lines.zh: 哦，对。我都忘了你{i}确实{/i}爱他。看来其他人基本都已经放弃她了。

lines.en: : Uta-chan’s not the type to give up on anybody. {i}Especially{/i} sad girls with questionable sexual preferences as we have learned here today.
lines.zh: Uta 酱可不是会放弃任何人的那种人。{i}尤其是{/i}像我们今天知道的这样，性取向有点问题的悲伤女孩。

lines.en: : We’re an entire class of sad girls with questionable sexual preferences, though. We need to draw the line somewhere, don’t we?
lines.zh: 可我们整个班都是性取向有点问题的悲伤女孩啊。总得在什么地方画条线吧？

lines.en: : Learning how to accept Ami is a problem for future-Chika. You know — the one who stays with Sensei and lets the girl she’s way more compatible with get away.
lines.zh: 学着接受 Ami 是未来 Chika 才要操心的问题。就是那个留在 Sensei 身边、却让和她合得来得多的女孩溜走的 Chika。

lines.en: : Is that really a future you’d be happy with, Chika? Waiting at home all by yourself just to have him come back smelling like another girl?
lines.zh: 那样的未来你真的会开心吗，Chika？一个人守在家里，等他带着别的女人的味道回来？

lines.en: scene chikautabed31
: At least with enough practice, I’ll know who’s who based on scent alone and can properly send out threatening letters to the correct addresses.
lines.zh: 至少练得够多之后，我光靠气味就能分辨出是谁，好把恐吓信准确寄到正确的地址。

lines.en: : And if he comes home smelling like {i}Rin?{/i} Then what?
lines.zh: 那如果他回来时身上带的是{i}Rin{/i}的味道呢？那你怎么办？

lines.en: : I will either strangle him to death or passionately suck him off to further indulge in that scent.
lines.zh: 我要么把他掐死，要么热情地给他口一发，好更尽情地品味那个味道。

lines.en: : I am currently leaning toward the former, but am open to growing into a more accepting lover in the future.
lines.zh: 目前我更倾向前者，不过也愿意日后成长为一个更包容的恋人。

lines.en: : You’ll figure this out, Chika. I know you will. You’re the most mature out of everybody when you’re not acting all crazy and trying to murder the competition. Or your partner.
lines.zh: 你会想通的，Chika。我知道你会。只要你不犯疯、不去谋杀情敌——或者你的伴侣——你算是所有人里最成熟的了。

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, I feel more sane right now than I have in a really long time. Only a matter of time until that streak is broken, though.
lines.zh: 说来奇怪，我现在的状态是好久以来最清醒的。不过这种状态早晚会被打破。

lines.en: : Rin’s {i}really{/i} gunning for him now and it is forcing me into a state of jealousy that makes me very frustrated both sexually {i}and{/i} emotionally.
lines.zh: Rin 现在{i}真的{/i}在卯足劲追他，这逼得我陷入一种嫉妒里，让我在性方面{i}和{/i}情感上都憋得很难受。

lines.en: : If I was the type to take initiative, I might offer to lend a hand with both of those things right now.
lines.zh: 如果我是那种会主动的人，我现在说不定会提出帮你解决这两件事。

lines.en: scene chikautabed32
: And I might agree because knowing you have to take care of yourself all the time makes me feel very bad for you.
lines.zh: 我说不定会答应，因为一想到你只能自己解决，我就挺同情你的。

lines.en: : I can guarantee you that no one feels worse about this than myself!
lines.zh: 我可以保证，没人比我更为此感到难受了！

lines.en: scene black
: Let’s get dinner before things get even more explicit, though. You should understand the weight of your words when it comes to a permanent virgin like me.
lines.zh: 不过在话题变得更露骨之前，我们先去吃饭吧。对着我这种永久处女，你该知道你那些话的分量。

lines.en: : There’s always Ami.
lines.zh: 不是还有 Ami 嘛。

lines.en: : {i}Didn’t I just say a little while ago that doing stuff like that with people you work with is inappropriate and wrong?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我刚才不是才说过，跟一起工作的人做那种事不合适也不对吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, you did. That’s normally the stuff that’s the hottest, though.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}是啊，你说过。不过通常这种事才最刺激。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ugh...I really hate how right you are.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}呃……我真讨厌你这么有道理。{/i}

lines.en: $ beachsix5 = True
$ chika_love += 1
$ uta_love += 1
{i}Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Chika’s affection has increased as well! Just with the caveat that she thinks of someone else sometimes.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度也提升了！只是附带一个前提：她有时会想着别人。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I’m sure that won’t hurt you at all, Frog Boy.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我敢肯定这一点都不会伤到你的，青蛙小子。{/i}
